summary: An argument was of the wrong kind or outside the range the function accepts.
description: An argument was of the wrong kind or outside the range the function accepts. This is what most `requireX` guards throw.
Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.
